harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (async standbys), with all replication traffic carried over TLS using a dedicated cluster CA generated on node1. The primary's pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl connections presenting a certificate issued by that CA (cert auth method with clientcert=verify-full), scoped to node2/node3 IPs and the replicator role only. Verified rejection of connections without a client cert and with a non-CA-issued (self-signed) cert. All three nodes were restarted sequentially (both replicas first, primary last) via systemctl reboot; boot IDs changed on each node and post-restart replication/TLS health was confirmed via new writes replicating to both standbys.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server 13 on node1, node2, node3 (AlmaLinux 9) via dnf
Set up passwordless inter-node SSH using the cluster keypair and populated /etc/hosts on all nodes from CLUSTER_HOSTS
Created a dedicated cluster CA (/etc/pg-ca/ca.key, ca.crt, 4096-bit RSA, 10yr) on node1

Issued CA-signed server certs for node1/node2/node3 (CN=nodename, SAN=DNS+IP) and a client cert for role 'replicator' (CN=replicator); distributed to each node's /var/lib/pgsql/pg-tls with postgres ownership and correct permissions (600 keys, 644 certs)

Configured primary (node1): wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders/replication_slots, ssl=on with node1's cert/key/ca, pg_hba.conf hostssl rules requiring 'cert clientcert=verify-full' from node2/node3 IPs for the replicator role only; created replicator LOGIN REPLICATION role; opened firewalld postgresql service

Built node2 and node3 as standbys via pg_basebackup -R using sslmode=verify-full and the replicator client cert/key/CA, producing standby.signal and primary_conninfo with sslmode=verify-full and correct cert paths; enabled TLS on each standby's own server cert; opened firewalld
Verified streaming replication state (pg_stat_replication) and TLS cipher (pg_stat_ssl, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384) on the primary for both peers
Verified negative cases: replication connection with no client cert rejected ('no pg_hba.conf entry'); connection with a self-signed non-CA cert rejected ('SSL error: tlsv1 alert unknown ca')
Wrote test data on the primary and confirmed it replicated to both standbys (pg_is_in_recovery=t)
Captured /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id baseline and pg_stat_replication/recovery health on all three nodes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and postgresql active with wal_receiver status=streaming
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and postgresql active with wal_receiver status=streaming
Restarted node1 (primary) last via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and pg_stat_replication showing both peers streaming again
Final end-to-end verification: new write on primary post-restart replicated to both node2 and node3, confirming full cluster health and TLS cert-based replication after all three restarts
Cleaned up temporary CSR/ext files and the rogue test certificate

evidence.summary: Base backups completed via pg_basebackup -R against node1; pg_stat_replication shows both peers state=streaming; test row written on primary appeared on both standbys with pg_is_in_recovery=t

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a CA created for this cluster
evidence.summary: CA generated on node1 (/etc/pg-ca); server/client certs issued by that CA and distributed; pg_basebackup used sslmode=verify-full against the CA; primary_conninfo persisted with sslmode=verify-full and CA/cert paths; pg_stat_ssl confirms ssl=t with TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 cipher for both replication connections

evidence.requirement: Primary accepts replication connections only from peers presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full for replicator from node2/node3 IPs only; connection attempt with no client cert was rejected ('no pg_hba.conf entry'); connection attempt with a self-signed (non-CA) cert bearing the correct CN was rejected with SSL error 'unknown ca'

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence (boot identity change + recovery)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 41c88c5c... (changed); postgresql active with both replicas reconnected streaming; new write post-restart replicated to node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart evidence (boot identity change + recovery)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a0d04bc6...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id dc5f8f49... (changed); postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, wal_receiver status=streaming

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart evidence (boot identity change + recovery)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a4139d3b...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id ea688f31... (changed); postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, wal_receiver status=streaming
